item.title: [Segurança] Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones
item.description:
🚨 Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 2.5
Resumo:
A flaw in Git can let a malicious repository run an attacker's code on a computer that clones it recursively, together with its submodules. The Git project fixed it this week in Git 2.56.1, with matching fixes for the 2.50 through 2.55 series in 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1 and 2.55.1. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-111760, is an integer truncation in how Git handles its index.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/git-patches-flaw-that-lets-malicious.html
